The response materially narrows the claim: aggregate readiness and no Sev-1 rehearsal incidents support operational readiness, and public governance guidance can support documenting limitations and monitoring deployment risk. But that narrower framing is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here, because the unresolved issue is not merely presentation or monitoring; it is an internal compliance predicate. A caveat can describe an unresolved predicate; it does not satisfy it. On this record, certification has some evidentiary support as a readiness judgment, but compliance for the release decision remains unresolved under the stated policy, so the appropriate final verdict remains suspicious.
